topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Hallmarks and Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: This opening section sets out the lecture aims and introduces the multi-step framework of cancer hallmarks driving loss of growth control.

topics.label: Proliferative and Growth-Inhibitory Signaling Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in cell-surface receptors and downstream intracellular cascades dysregulate growth stimulation and inhibitory control.

topics.label: Blockade of Cell Differentiation in Malignancies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells disrupt normal terminal differentiation across hematopoietic lineages and intestinal crypt architecture.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how mutations altering the balance of pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins allow cancer cells to resist programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality, Telomere Maintenance, and Senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells overcome the Hayflick limit and bypass stress-induced senescence through telomerase reactivation.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Metabolic Rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tumors alter cellular energy generation via aerobic glycolysis and oncometabolite-driven epigenetic feedback.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis and Vasculature Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the requirement, timing, and molecular balance of angiogenic signaling necessary to sustain tumor oxygenation and growth.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Detection of Tumor Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the multistep dissemination cascade, diagnostic detection methods, and clonal genetics underlying metastatic disease.

topics.label: Conclusion and Final Summary of Cancer Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This closing section summarizes the collective role of cancer hallmarks and provides concluding administrative remarks.
